item.title: St. Vincent de Paul keeps shelter open as temperatures drop
item.description: St. Vincent de Paul of Baton Rouge is keeping its warming shelter open this weekend due to the dangerously low temperatures forecasted, providing overnight shelter, warmth, and meals as capacity allows.

item.title: Louisiana jail escapees captured through multi-agency effort
item.description: All eight inmates who escaped from the Riverbend Detention Center in East Carroll Parish have been apprehended and returned to custody thanks to the coordinated efforts of local and federal law enforcement.

item.title: District 6 Councilman Cleve Dunn Jr. released from EBR Parish Prison on 25k bond
item.description: Cleve Dunn Jr., Baton Rouge City Council member for District 6, was booked and released on charges of theft, money laundering, public bribery, and other offenses.

item.title: Shooting at Mardi Gras parade in Clinton leaves 5 injured
item.description: A shooting in front of the East Feliciana Parish Courthouse during a Mardi Gras parade on Saturday left five people injured, including a 6-year-old boy.
